description:
[Trading Data API] Transaction count (nonce) for an address or ENS name: confirmed nonce plus pending nonce, so an agent can sign the next transaction without a collision. — Transaction count (nonce) for an address or ENS name: confirmed nonce plus pending nonce, so an agent can sign the next transaction without a collision.

**Example:** `/v1/chain-nonce?address=0xB71C06dAC44c91bc997FB84C247DeEF676F4A9f6&chain=base`

address.description: Required. A 0x address or an ENS name.

chain.description: Optional. ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon (default base).

name: chain_nonce
